# ambiguous-attribution-for-bootstrap-compiles

which_pr_introduced returns a special note when the CompileRun.pr_number is None (labelled as a full-compile bootstrap), which may lead callers to treat bootstrap-attributed additions differently; absence of PR attribution can complicate automated provenance workflows.
